note: Both sets correctly capture the naming convention (211 = 21.1%, 241 = 24.1%) and the Figure 3 conditions (FFA-W3-211, Re = 10E+6), and both share the dubious claim of Cl = 1.5 at AoA ≈ 15 deg, which conflicts with their own Cl ≈ 1.8 at 15 deg. Set A adds several plausible, well-conditioned chart reads (L/D ≈ 140 at Cl ≈ 1.2, L/D ≈ -60 at Cl = -0.7, Cl ≈ -1.0 at AoA = -20 deg) that are bound to the right curves and axes. Set B instead mislabels a point value as 'maximum lift coefficient 1.8' with contradictory conditions (Mixed, AoA ≈ 15 deg), offers a vague axis-label quote for Cl = 0.0 at AoA = 0 deg, and repeats the thickness/Reynolds facts several times with one garbled quote. Overall Set A has fewer misbound or unsupported claims while covering the same key facts.
